dogecoin.text:
In order to buy DOGECOIN I had to do the following:
Use rands to buy Bitcoin (in dollars)
Use the Bitcoin to buy Dogecoin

In essence I’m exposed to :
1. Currency risk for USD vs Rand
2. Bitcoin price change
3. Dogecoin price change

This is far from speculation, it’s madness! 😂

I doubled my investments in Dogecoin,
Now I’m sitting here wondering to pull everything out or just hold for th mooon 😂
Dogecoin to the fucken moon , let’s hop!!!
